nodes.description: Public function that destroys the contract and forwards the whole balance to msg.sender after checking destructor() == msg.sender and that self-destruction is not disabled.
Public one-way switch that disables self-destruction; guarded only by require(destructor() == msg.sender).
View accessor returning the deployer address, which is the only account allowed to trigger self-destruction.
Privileged setter for the deployer role, guarded by onlyDeployer and notNullOrThisAddress.
Privileged setter for the operator role, guarded by onlyOperator and notNullOrThisAddress.
Deployer-only function registering a service whose activation is deferred by serviceActivationTimeout.
Private helper that sets registeredServicesMap flag and computes activationTimestamp = block.timestamp + timeout.
View function comparing block.timestamp against the service activationTimestamp to decide whether a registered service is active.
View function combining active-service status and per-action enablement; used as access-control gate for service callers.
Payable deposit entry point that credits msg.value into periodAccrual/aggregateAccrual and txHistory for a given wallet.
Token deposit entry point that resolves a transfer controller and delegatecalls it to pull tokens, then updates accrual balances.
Operator-only revenue distribution loop that computes pro-rata fractions and pushes ETH/tokens to beneficiaries via external calls.
Payable fallback function that forwards msg.sender into receiveEthersTo.
Deployer-only registration of a beneficiary with a positive int256 fraction, bounded by PARTS_PER using SafeMathIntLib.
Deployer-only deregistration that subtracts the stored fraction from totalBeneficiaryFraction.
Deployer-only removal of a beneficiary from the beneficiaries array with swap-and-pop index remapping.
Publicly callable function that pulls maxNullNonce from the community vote contract and overwrites local state.
Resolves the transfer controller address for a currency/standard pair, reverting for unregistered or blacklisted currencies.
Checked int256 addition used for beneficiary fraction accounting.
Checked int256 multiplication used in pro-rata revenue computation.
Deployer-only setter for the community vote contract instance, blocked once communityVoteFrozen is set.
Boolean flag that permanently disables triggerSelfDestruction once set.
Address holding the deployer role; also returned by destructor() as self-destruction authority.
Address holding the operator role.
Mapping of service address to ServiceInfo (registered flag, activationTimestamp, enabled actions).
Deferral delay in seconds applied to deferred service registrations.
FungibleBalanceLib.Balance holding the current period accrual per currency.
FungibleBalanceLib.Balance holding the cumulative accrual per currency.
TxHistoryLib.TxHistory recording deposits and withdrawals.
Sum of all beneficiary fractions; must equal PARTS_PER before accrual can be closed.
Private mapping of beneficiary address to granted fraction.
Array of registered beneficiary addresses iterated during revenue distribution.
Maximum accepted null settlement nonce, updatable from community vote.
Mapping from standard hash to controller address used to resolve delegatecall targets.
Reference to the CommunityVote contract consulted for nonce and data availability decisions.
Caller-controlled address used for role checks, service gates, deposit crediting and self-destruct payout.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for service activation checks.
Self-destruct instruction transferring the entire contract balance to the caller.
Delegatecall into the resolved transfer controller using the controller-supplied receive signature.
Delegatecall into the resolved transfer controller's approve to authorise payout to a beneficiary.
External ETH push to a beneficiary address inside the distribution loop.
External call into the community vote contract to fetch the maximum null nonce.
int256 multiplication and division of period accrual by beneficiary fraction and PARTS_PER.
External call back into each beneficiary contract to close its accrual period.
New deployer address supplied to setDeployer.
New operator address supplied to setOperator.
Service contract address passed to the service registration functions.
Action name string hashed and checked for enablement.
Wallet address credited during ether deposits.
Token amount deposited and added into accrual balances.
Currency contract address used for controller resolution and balance indexing.
Currency identifier used for balance indexing and transfers.
Token standard string used to select a transfer controller.
Array of currencies iterated when closing an accrual period.
Beneficiary address registered, deregistered or paid out.
Fraction of revenue granted to a beneficiary, stored as int256.
Deferral timeout passed into _registerService.
Running remainder of period accrual for a currency during distribution.
Pro-rata amount computed for a beneficiary, clamped to the remaining accrual.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against destructor() to authorise self-destruction.
msg.sender is compared against destructor() to authorise disabling self-destruction.
destructor() returns the deployer state variable that defines the destructor role.
triggerSelfDestruction reverts unless destructor() equals msg.sender.
disableSelfDestruction reverts unless destructor() equals msg.sender.
selfDestructionDisabled is required to be false before self-destruction executes.
disableSelfDestruction permanently sets selfDestructionDisabled to true.
onlyDeployer modifier checks msg.sender against deployer in setDeployer.
deployer is compared with msg.sender by the onlyDeployer modifier.
onlyOperator modifier checks msg.sender against operator in setOperator.
operator is compared with msg.sender by the onlyOperator modifier.
registerServiceDeferred is guarded by onlyDeployer which inspects msg.sender.
setCommunityVote is guarded by onlyDeployer which inspects msg.sender.
closeAccrualPeriod is guarded by onlyOperator which inspects msg.sender.
isEnabledServiceAction checks msg.sender against registered and enabled service actions.
block.timestamp is compared with the service activationTimestamp, making activation miner-influenceable.
activationTimestamp is derived from block.timestamp plus the timeout.
serviceActivationTimeout is used as the deferral offset in _registerService.
registeredServicesMap supplies the activationTimestamp compared in isRegisteredActiveService.
isEnabledServiceAction builds on isRegisteredActiveService.
onlyActiveService passes msg.sender into isRegisteredActiveService.
service parameter is the address registered by registerServiceDeferred.
registerServiceDeferred delegates the storage write to _registerService.
timeout parameter is added to block.timestamp inside _registerService.
service parameter indexes registeredServicesMap inside _registerService.
Fallback forwards execution to receiveEthersTo with msg.sender.
Fallback reads msg.sender to build the deposit credit.
receiveEthersTo uses msg.sender as the credited wallet source.
wallet parameter is emitted in ReceiveEvent for the deposit.
periodAccrual balance is increased by the deposited amount.
aggregateAccrual balance is increased by the deposited amount.
deposit entry is appended to txHistory.
receiveTokensTo resolves the transfer controller for the currency and standard.
the resolved controller address is used as the delegatecall target.
currencyCt parameter selects the controller when no standard is given.
standard parameter takes priority in controller resolution.
registeredTransferControllers mapping is read to resolve the controller address.
receiveTokensTo delegatecalls the controller receive function to pull tokens.
amount parameter is validated and added into accrual balances.
currencyId parameter indexes the accrual balances and txHistory.
msg.sender is passed as the transfer source in the delegatecall.
periodAccrual.add(amount, currencyCt, currencyId) is executed.
aggregateAccrual.add(amount, currencyCt, currencyId) is executed.
txHistory.addDeposit records the token deposit.
closeAccrualPeriod multiplies period accrual by beneficiary fraction and divides by PARTS_PER.
SafeMathIntLib.mul backs the pro-rata fraction computation.
periodAccrual balance is the multiplicand of the distribution formula.
beneficiary fraction is the multiplier of the distribution formula.
remaining accrual is reduced by the computed transferable amount.
transferable local is produced by the fraction multiplication.
the distribution loop pushes ETH to a beneficiary via .value() and then keeps iterating.
the beneficiary ETH transfer is an external callback that can re-enter closeAccrualPeriod before state is finalised.
closeAccrualPeriod delegatecalls controller.approve before pushing tokens to a beneficiary.
closeAccrualPeriod calls back into each beneficiary contract to close its accrual period.
beneficiary callback executes while the fund's accrual state is still mid-update.
closeAccrualPeriod resolves a transfer controller for token payouts.
beneficiaries array is iterated to determine payouts.
currencies parameter drives the outer distribution loop.
totalBeneficiaryFraction must equal PARTS_PER before distribution is allowed.
periodAccrual balances are read to compute each payee's share.
periodAccrual.set(remaining, currencyCt, currencyId) rolls unused accrual forward.
beneficiary address is used to look up fractions and push funds.
fraction parameter is validated as positive and bounded by PARTS_PER.
totalBeneficiaryFraction is increased by the new fraction.
registerFractionalBeneficiary uses SafeMathIntLib.add for fraction accounting.
the checked addition result is stored into totalBeneficiaryFraction.
beneficiary parameter is registered through the parent benefactor.
_beneficiaryFractionMap[beneficiary] is assigned the granted fraction.
beneficiary parameter is deregistered from the benefactor.
the beneficiary fraction is zeroed after deregistration.
totalBeneficiaryFraction is reduced by the removed fraction.
deregisterBeneficiary relies on SafeMathIntLib arithmetic on int256 fractions.
beneficiary parameter is removed from the beneficiaries array.
swap-and-pop mutates beneficiaries and decrements its length.
updateMaxNullNonceFromCommunityVote reads the communityVote contract reference.
the communityVote address is the target of the getMaxNullNonce external call.
maxNullNonce is overwritten with the value returned by the community vote.
the returned max null nonce flows back into the state update.
updateMaxNullNonceFromCommunityVote is externally callable with no role check and mutates nonce state.
setCommunityVote writes the communityVote state variable.
setCommunityVote reads the current communityVote to build the change event.
selfdestruct sends the entire contract balance to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
triggerSelfDestruction executes the selfdestruct instruction.

normalization_plan.reason: The newDeployer parameter only exists to feed the owner-role setter and carries no independent behaviour.
The newOperator parameter is only used to update the operator role inside setOperator.
The service address parameter is immediately consumed by the service registration routine.
The action string parameter is hashed and checked only within the service action enablement gate.
The wallet parameter is only used as the credited wallet of the ether deposit routine.
The amount parameter is validated and folded into the accrual balances of the token deposit routine.
The currencyCt parameter is used to resolve the currency controller and is thus mergeable into that resolver.
The currencyId parameter only indexes the token balance bookkeeping of the deposit routine.
The standard string only influences which transfer controller is returned by the resolver.
The currencies array is iterated exclusively by the accrual period closing routine.
The beneficiary address parameter is the key of the fraction registration operation.
The fraction parameter is validated and stored by the fractional beneficiary registration.
The timeout parameter is only added to block.timestamp inside the registration helper.
The remaining local tracks the accrual left to distribute inside the closing loop.
The transferable local is the direct result of the pro-rata multiplication and division operation.
